heading: Moon & icon: Menphina's Medallion, round three
intro:
You kept concept D and set A, B and C aside. Round three enhances D with the feedback you passed on and the panel's fixes. A realism supervisor then checked every glyph and the icon for light, shadow, reflection, colour and material before anything reached this page.

What you asked for: the aetheryte crystal is gone, and all eight medals now share one gilt rim. States are told apart by what is inside the medal, not by the colour of its border. D is also richer: one light from the upper left on everything, the moon road redrawn as real ripples, and the lantern casting its own warm reflection.

Nothing is final. Vote or comment on the round-three card, and try the moons in the working mock of the plugin below.

before.name: Round two D
before.text: The panel's lead: 6.9 for glyphs and 7.5 for the icon. At 16 px it had rims in three colours (gilt, pewter and red), an aetheryte crystal on the island, and rows that read as radio buttons.

concepts.name: Menphina's Medallion, enhanced
concepts.pitch: Every quest state is a minted FFXIV job-icon medal: a moon emblem on lapis enamel in one shared champagne-gilt bevel. The icon is the moon road on calm water past a stone lantern, with each light reflected directly beneath it.
changes: Aetheryte crystal removed; the far shore is an unlit headland, so the only lights are the moon and the lantern
One shared gilt rim on all eight medals and the icon frame, lit from the upper left
Ready: the bezel opens at the bottom and the moon road spills out of it, so it reads by shape alone
Ready on another job: a violet soul crystal in a gilt setting, after the job stones
The check moved to Completed; Done this cycle has a gilt arc meaning it comes back
Locked out: a cracked Dalamud in rose-crimson, matching the plugin's Eclipse colour
Not checked: one tapered mist wisp over a hazy moon, with no ring
Icon: a 12-row moon road brightest at the moon's mirror point, a warm lantern reflection, and moon and road kept clear of the Installed check
watch: The weakest pair (Blocked vs Locked out, 12.8) clears the bar, but only just
Done this cycle's arc is new, so the panel needs to confirm it doesn't read as a bracket
Ready on a bright daylight ground relies on its open bezel more than on contrast

supervisor.summary:
The supervisor checked rendered images, never source, against one rule: realistic light, shadow, reflection, colour and material, even in stylised art.

  • Art, round one: 14 fixes. Mirror slices were moved to the mirror point. The road was re-spaced so it foreshortens. Glints became thin streaks. The lantern got its own warm reflection. The sky gradient was un-inverted. The ribbon was folded behind the medal. The check now breaks the rim.
  • Art, round two: one fix. The lantern's light pool moved in front of its base, where the light can actually reach.
  • Plugin mock: 16 fixes, then 2. The mock now matches the real 1.10 window: overlay content, the colour of the state words, quick views, the three-row action bar, and an ImGui look with no window shadows. The game-screen credit stays visible at every size.

Full reviews: docs/design/moon-v6/round3/supervisor/.

archive.note: Four concepts scored by a six-juror panel from rendered images, after a blind test. You kept D, which became round three, and set A, B and C aside.

items.name: Aether Crystal Moon
items.pitch: Moonstone moons in a job-icon rim; the lit part is cut crystal and only Ready glows. Icon: crystal glints form the moon road under a crescent.
liked: best row legibility and distinctness (weakest pair 17.6)
Ready's road breaks the circle, so it can be found by shape alone, even colour-blind
calm cool moonstone, no cheese
favourite glyph set of the veteran raider and colour-blind jurors
failed: Locked out reads as a no-entry sign (all six jurors)
Completed reads as a coin or gem
Done reads as a check-circle
Not checked reads as a hamburger menu at 16 px
Ready at 16 px reads as a lollipop or magnifier; teal glow looks like a mobile-game claim button
icon road reads as stepping stones; aetheryte is a speck

items.name: Astrologian's Orrery
items.pitch: Each moon sits in a small Sharlayan astrolabe with engraved ticks and constellations. Icon: a round gilt medallion with Dalamud as Menphina's small red companion.
liked: Blocked's engraved constellation
Dalamud as a small rose moon in the icon
round icon matches the Ready glyph exactly
failed: 24 rim ticks read as sun rays, decoration with no meaning
Ready reads as a lightbulb or user icon at 16 px, with two pills below
Not checked reads as Saturn
Completed reads as a gold coin
Locked out reads as a stray slash
icon road is a brick stack as bright as the moon; ring reads as a clock

items.name: Ishgard Glass
items.pitch: The moon as a cathedral stained-glass roundel with gilt lead lines; Locked out in Dalamud-red glass. Icon: a glass moon over water below an Ishgard skyline.
liked: most specific FFXIV idea (Ishgard stained glass)
Ishgard skyline in the icon is the best FFXIV detail of the round
Blocked is the prettiest single moon
failed: lead lines vanish below 48 px, leaving plain discs in game
Locked out reads as a no-entry sign
Ready reads as a lollipop or hand mirror
Not checked nearly disappears on daylight scenes
Ready on another job reads as an AI sparkle
icon moon is a gilt-framed plate (lemon slice, clock) its reflection cannot match; road is a hex pyramid

items.name: Menphina's Medallion (round two)
items.pitch: Each state a minted job-icon medal, gilt for Ready and pewter for the rest. Icon: the moon road leading past a stone lantern to a crystal isle.
liked: most FFXIV-feeling family, built like job-icon medals
finest detail at large sizes
cracked red Dalamud is the only Locked out that is not a no-entry sign
Ready, a moon over the sea in a gilt medal, is the best Ready in the panel
icon reflection sits under the lit crescent in the same colour, dimmer and broken, answering the round-1 complaint
lantern and aetheryte island give the icon a sense of place
failed: same rim on all eight makes the row look like radio buttons at 16 px
Blocked and Completed read as a hollow and filled radio button pair
Ready on another job reads as a contrast toggle
Done reads as a check-circle; Not checked as a hamburger in a ring
Ready's only greyscale cue is its gold rim
icon glints nearly as bright as the moon and look like leaves; road touches the Installed checkmark; moon is the plainest element
over the new-colour budget

archive.note: Three concepts and a refined final. The round-one panel judged the SVG files without seeing renders, which round two corrected. You rejected the final set: the glyphs read as generic icons and the icon's reflection didn't match its moon.

items.name: Sumi to Kinpaku, refined
items.pitch: The round-one pick after refinement: a flat light shape in a sumi-ink well, with gold leaf only as a line or seal and at most one mark per state. Icon: a crescent over a gold moon road.
liked: Every state had its own shape and passed the round's legibility checks
Calm, with no cheese texture
failed: Read as a stock status-icon set: contrast toggle, radio button, no-entry sign, check-circle
The sumi well vanished on the Night background, so the moons looked like bare outlines
Icon: the gold road sat left of the lit crescent and was about three times more saturated than the moon

items.name: Sumi to Kinpaku
items.pitch: Ink and gold leaf: pale moon shapes in sumi wells, kamon-style framing, gold only as line or seal.
liked: Every juror's favourite in round one
Reads as one family, in Japanese moon-viewing style
failed: Japanese, but not FFXIV
Flat, with no material: the gold was a flat stroke

items.name: Moonlight Hairline
items.pitch: The moon drawn as a light source: flat, crisp moonlight shapes with hairline brass and silver lines, and a gold halo as the one signal to act now.
liked: Ready's detached gold halo was the loudest glyph in a row
Its crescent matched the icon
failed: Blocked, Locked out and Not checked had no moon cue at all
A halo ring around the moon echoed the plugin's progress ring

items.name: Tsukigasa
items.pitch: Luminous minimalism around the moon halo (tsukigasa): soft rings and pale discs, with a broken, asymmetric shimmer on the icon's water.
liked: Its broken, asymmetric water shimmer was carried into the final icon
Its cool silver for Completed was adopted
failed: Hardest set to tell apart: weakest pair 6.8 at 16 px
Blocked, Locked out and Not checked collapsed into similar rings
